description: Empiric treatment or prophylaxis for human, dog, and cat bite wounds. Mapped from DKR bite_wounds.json (id bite_wound_infection); TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02. Consult ID for all other bite wounds (not human, dog, or cat).

oral.description: Oral therapy when the patient can take an oral agent

iv.description: IV therapy if unable to take an oral agent

prophylaxis_indications.description: Consider antibiotic prophylaxis for: deep wounds (especially cat bites), wounds on face/hands/genitals, immunocompromised/asplenic patients, or wounds near prosthetic material.

categories.duration: Prophylaxis 3-5 days; mild infection 5-7 days; severe/complicated 7-14 days

regimens.reasoning: First-line oral therapy for human, dog, and cat bite wounds (TUH 2025-04-02)
regimens.evidence: TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02

regimens.reasoning: Metronidazole plus one aerobic agent for mild PCN allergy (rash). DKR conditionalAdjuncts: select one of doxycycline, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, or levofloxacin.
regimens.note: Select one adjunct: doxycycline, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, or levofloxacin

regimens.reasoning: Metronidazole plus one aerobic agent for severe PCN allergy (anaphylaxis). DKR conditionalAdjuncts: select one of doxycycline, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, or levofloxacin.

categories.duration: Prophylaxis 3-5 days; mild infection 5-7 days; severe/complicated 7-14 days

regimens.reasoning: IV therapy if unable to take an oral agent (TUH 2025-04-02 rank 2)

regimens.reasoning: IV ceftriaxone plus metronidazole if unable to take oral agent with mild PCN allergy
IV doxycycline plus metronidazole for severe PCN allergy when oral therapy is not possible

de_escalation.criteria: Duration depends on indication: prophylaxis 3-5 days; mild infection 5-7 days; severe/complicated 7-14 days
de_escalation.note: Thorough wound irrigation and examination. Evaluate for tetanus and/or rabies post-exposure prophylaxis. Consult ID for bites that are not human, dog, or cat.
